subject: Q3 hiring roadmap — backfill approvals & freeze recommendations
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 hiring roadmap — backfill approvals & freeze recommendations

Hi team,

As we start QBR prep I want to lock the headcount roadmap for Q3 so we have clear asks for the exec review. A few constraints to keep in mind: expected revenue cadence looks conservative, and we should be prepared to recommend targeted freezes for low-priority reqs while ensuring critical backfills (ops, infra, customer-facing) move forward.

Ask: can each of you confirm the reqs you consider mission-critical vs. candidates for freeze by EOD Monday? I'll consolidate and propose the list for the leadership packet. Specifics I need:
- Req ID / role title / team
- Business impact (1-3 sentence)
- If backfill, whether headcount can be re-allocated temporarily
- If hiring is paused, estimate impact to delivery (weeks/months)

Markus — I expect your list will include the infra SRE backfills and possibly a senior model engineer role. Laura — please include CS backfills and any renewal-related hiring. Rishi/Priyom — flag anything you think we should expedite (candidates in final stages).

Attachment: I'll share my draft prioritization once I have inputs; attaching a blank template XLA for consistency.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

--

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 hiring roadmap — backfill approvals & freeze recommendations

Evelyn —

Thanks for kicking this off. I've attached an updated proposal that categorizes reqs by tier (Critical / Important / Defer). Quick highlights:
- Critical: SRE (backfill), Edge GPU infra engineer (backfill), Customer Integrations lead (replacement)
- Important: Data infra (can be deprioritized 6-8 weeks if needed)
- Defer: Internal tooling PM (low immediate impact)

Notes on the senior model engineer: strong case but candidate pipeline is thin; if we pause, we risk a small slow-down in the model onboarding cadence (~4 weeks).

I recommend approving the three critical backfills and placing the internal tooling PM and one growth-engineer req on a temporary freeze.

On process: I'll review the spreadsheet with Rishi Monday and confirm the exact req IDs.

Best,
Markus
VP Engineering
Redwood Inference

Thanks all — quick read and my decisions below so we can turn this into the QBR slide deck next week.

Approved (please move to exec packet):
- CS Lead (backfill) — high impact for renewals this quarter, risk to MRR if open
- Integrations Engineer (backfill) — needed to unblock partner rollouts

Conditional approvals (require cross-team alignment):
- Senior Model Engineer — approve if we can commit to a 60-day timeline and a bench candidate; otherwise defer.

Freeze recommendations:
- Internal tooling PM (defer to next hiring window)
- One Growth Engineer (pause until next quarter)

Priyom/Rishi: please prepare a short mutual action plan for the approved reqs (owners, timelines, interview rounding) and share the candidate status. I'll flag the approved items in the deck and add notes on risk.
